description: This file implements the DirectoryLister class for directory listing operations, including sorting and cancellation handling, within the net namespace.

classes.name: DirectoryLister
classes.description: Manages directory listing operations, including starting, canceling, and delegating file list results.

classes.name: DirectoryLister::Core
classes.description: Handles the core logic of directory enumeration, including sorting, cancellation, and callback invocation.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::Start
methods.description: Initiates the directory listing process on a background thread.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::Cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing directory listing operation.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::OnListFile
methods.description: Delegate callback for each listed file.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::OnListDone
methods.description: Delegate callback when listing is complete or an error occurs.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::Core::Start
methods.description: Performs the directory enumeration, sorts results, and posts completion callback.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::Core::CancelOnOriginSequence
methods.description: Sets cancellation flag to stop ongoing enumeration.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::Core::DoneOnOriginSequence
methods.description: Invokes delegate callbacks with the enumeration results or error.
